summary: Full regression on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844): day-01 scenarios S1–S13, product smoke, and day-02/03/04 smoke. Core add/toggle/delete/trim/empty/long/keyboard flows passed with no console errors. One bug: double-clicking Delete removes two todos because the next row slides under the pointer.

bugs.title: Double-clicking Delete removes two todos
steps: Add todos Alpha, Beta, and Gamma
Double-click the Delete button on Alpha
Reload and repeat the same steps to confirm
bugs.expected: Only Alpha is removed; Beta and Gamma remain.
bugs.actual: Alpha and Beta are both removed; only Gamma remains. Same result on mobile.
